deities.name: Ishtanora
deities.rationale: Hearth hospitality, orchards, cultivated plenty, and peaceful household life directly reflect Ishtanora’s domains.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Thalunesh
deities.rationale: Mobile households and route-centered hospitality place travelers and messengers under Thalunesh’s protection.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

deities.name: Nebyrr
deities.rationale: Inheritance carried through households, guest bonds, and settled orchard communities connects them to lineage and social order.
deities.public_understanding: Recognized as a divine patron or associated deity within Universalian religious tradition.

note: These are broad cultural associations rather than compulsory worship; households, regions, and individuals may honor other deities.
